node.title: E1 profile-(2,10) cofactor-514 outer-energy exclusion
node.statement: No binding-row profile-(2,10,S=18) collision with cofactor 514 has autocorrelation energy 0 through 4 or 14 through 17. node.notes: ANALYTIC COFACTOR-514 CONTRACTION 2026-07-29: rational atanh margins and exact exponential comparisons remove nine of eighteen energy values without a support or norm census. Energies 5 through 13 and all 128 prime ideals above 257 remain; no E1 close or Prize movement.
